subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: Which installer npm failures should OpenClaw auto-retry or auto-repair, and where should the installer only print remediation guidance?
rationale: Source inspection shows a real diagnostics and recovery gap, but cross-platform npm prefix repair, transient-network retries, and optional probe strictness can change existing install behavior.

options.title: Define narrow policy first
options.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only transient idempotent network failures, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

options.title: Broader automatic repair
options.body: Attempt safe permission or prefix repairs after EACCES-style failures and retry only when the repair succeeds, with platform-specific tests and rollback behavior.

options.title: Keep partial diagnostics
options.body: Accept the current npm code/syscall/errno output and targeted cleanup retries without adding a broader installer error policy.

recommendation.title: Define narrow policy first
recommendation.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only transient idempotent network failures, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and current blame show the broadest current activity across the Bash installer and npm-prefix test surface.
